positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Upgraded automated tests so they could run reliably in Jenkins
Worked on SDK communicating with server over ReST interface
Developed UI pages using Angular.js
Assisted in the maintenance and bugfixing for products Inflight and VDirect
Developed reporting visualization tool using dimple.js for Inflight

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed ReSTful API for applications to interact with educational data.
Worked on ingestion pipeline to persist educational data in MongoDB database.
Developed data generation tool to build up large scale test data.
Worked on Ruby on Rails based admin tools application for onboarding developers and districts.
Prototyped a Hadoop based aggregate generation framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Agile Methodologies · Web Services · Agile

positions.title: Software Developer, IBM Systems Director
positions.description:
Developed and maintained software for IBM Systems Director Server to enable customers to manage their IBM systems
Worked on the core components for the Director server, and assisted other teams in making use of the core APIs for their components
Developed REST web service APIs for managing Director and integrating with other data center products using JAX-RS
Developed Hierarchical Management Server functionality for managing distributed Director Servers via REST APIs and JMS messaging queues
Performed performance analysis and debugged both performance and memory issues and assisted in making Director more scalable
Acted as a focal point and team lead for the development of code for managing endpoints
Acted as an advocate for automated unit testing with JUnit and functional testing with technologies such as Python and Java
Developed automated functional testing framework for REST APIs using Python

positions.title: Software Developer, Websphere Application Server
positions.description:
Developed new functionality to enhance the admin console (user interface layer) of the WAS server management section to make it easier for users to configure servers
Developed and maintained sections of core admin console framework in support for other components and stack products. Assisted other teams in using the core framework in the development of admin console panels
Acted as accessibility focal point for admin console development by interpreting and debugging accessibility related defects
Maintained WebSphere sample components that demonstrate to customers how to use IBM technology since taking over as WebSphere Samples Coordinator in February, 2007
Maintained the Internationalization Context Service component that allows users to configure locale specific information since taking over component in February, 2007

positions.title: Software Developer, Websphere XD
positions.description:
Developed run-time configuration code to allow creation and configuration of new XD objects
Developed admin console panels to expose configuration options in the web user interface
